scripts.dev: npm run dev --prefix server & npm run dev --prefix client
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.build:prod: npm ci --prefix server && npm ci --prefix client && npm run db:generate --prefix server && npm run build --prefix server && VITE_API_URL=/api npm run build --prefix client && rm -rf server/public && mkdir -p server/public && cp -R client/dist/. server/public/
scripts.start:prod: cd server && npx prisma db push && NODE_ENV=production node dist/index.js
